subject: Hospitality
title: Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion.

hook.text: Hospitality is one of the most diverse industries at entry level—but leadership remains overwhelmingly white and male.

buildup.text: Women make up 54% of hotel workers but hold only 20% of executive roles. The pipeline breaks at middle management.

discovery.text: Companies like Hilton and Hyatt now tie executive bonuses to diversity targets and track representation at every level.

twist.text: DEI backlash in some markets has led companies to rebrand programs. The work continues under different names.

climax.text: Research shows diverse leadership teams outperform. Hotels with inclusive cultures also score higher in guest satisfaction.

punchline.text: Diverse teams serve diverse guests better. Inclusion is a business advantage.

quiz.question: What percentage of hotel executive roles are held by women?
